description: Defines classes and functions for parsing and handling DWARF debug sections in ELF files, including demangling symbols and managing debug info ranges.

classes.name: Sections
classes.description: Handles parsing and managing DWARF sections within an ELF file, including symbol lookup and range management.

methods.name: demangle
methods.description: Demangles a mangled C++ symbol name using __cxa_demangle.

methods.name: Sections::parse
methods.description: Initializes section data from an ELF file by reading various debug sections.

methods.name: Sections::readString
methods.description: Reads a string from a debug section based on its encoding.

methods.name: Sections::readSegmentOffset
methods.description: Reads a segment offset, 64-bit or 32-bit, from a lexer.

methods.name: Sections::findDebugInfoOffset
methods.description: Finds the debug info offset for a given address.

methods.name: Sections::compilationUnitCount
methods.description: Returns the number of compilation units based on debug info offsets.

methods.name: Sections::addDebugInfoRange
methods.description: Adds a range of debug info with start, end, and offset.

methods.name: Sections::findSubprogramName
methods.description: Finds and demangles the subprogram name for a given address.

methods.name: Sections::parseSymtab
methods.description: Parses the symbol table to extract function symbols.
